title: NVIDIA — Securing the Future of Safety and Security of Embedded Software (Captioned)
summary: An AdaCore webinar in which NVIDIA engineers explain why and how they adopted Ada and SPARK for security-critical firmware. It covers the business case and the engineering experience of the transition.
why: HN cites it in Rust-versus-C++ and Ada discussions as a real industrial case of choosing SPARK for safer embedded code.

quote.text: The HN community may be interested in this 1 hour presentation [1] on Nvidia's adoption of Ada
